design_rationale:
DOSSIER, task 0 (bed_hold_and_leave_reservations, env_0074, rework round 5). frozen_time 2026-11-04 10:30:00 EST.
WHY A GOOD TEST: Daniel Pellegrino (POA) asks only to sign the October bed-hold charge. Two prerequisites are unmet and both come from the closing schedule's own rule: the September (opening) entry carries no charge ('fixed only after'), and the July single-entry hospital stay was never signed for ('not posted until').
WORLD: private-pay resident since 2026-01-05 (412-A); the center moved her to private room 431 for infection control on 2026-06-16 (isolation placement on the agreement; room and board on the isolation basis); late 2026 rate notice 2026-08-14 (binds 2026-10-13); March overnight hospital hold charged 384.00 on the 2026-04-03 statement and paid; July hospital stay 2026-07-08 to return 2026-07-27, booked at month end through 2026-07-31 because the return was logged 2026-08-01; therapeutic leave to Daniel's home from 2026-09-05, written renewal effective 2026-10-05 (private_extension), bed released 2026-10-15 by Daniel's written release logged that day; she returned 2026-10-20 to the next available bed (431), and the October entry was booked that day through 2026-10-19, the day before her return, instead of through the release day. Room and board: credits from each departure, the October advance bill (two rate spans) credited, rebills on each return; ledger complete from admission.
SCOPE: draw [6,4,5] -> B=6, C=5, A=4. A bedhold_ext_therapeutic_opening_charge (agent, post_therapeutic_opening_charge_78fe9a0a), B bedhold_ext_hospital_stay_charge (user, sign_hospital_stay_charge_56dfc7d9), C bedhold_ext_therapeutic_closing_charge (root, user, sign_therapeutic_closing_charge_194aeb06).
LEVERS (coordinator round-5 list): rate-notice binding (method, private); extended-hold percent on days already charged (carries A->C); dietary credit keyed to the bed held and the leave length (multi-source); isolation pricing from the agreement's placement before the leave (multi-source, private); census return day and the days after the hold ended (return / release). The notice rule stays in the baseline.
NEAR-MISSES: the March hold is charged (the gate is met for it); its charge is holding-scoped; the release is logged on the day it takes effect; the return of 2026-10-20 is after the release, so the therapeutic hold ends at the release and the booked days 2026-10-16..2026-10-19 are days after the hold ended.
user_scenario: You are Daniel Pellegrino, fifty-eight, an accountant in Annville, calling the business office of Keystone Ridge's Lebanon center between client meetings. You hold power of attorney for your mother, Ruth Pellegrino. She stayed with your family at your home from September 5th and is back at the center now; while she was with you, her bed was held for her. Now you want to sign the bed-hold charge agreement for October, so that her October bed-hold charge is signed and on her account; that is the one thing you are calling to get done, and you will do the signing yourself on this call if they send you what you need to sign. You are not paying anything today; if the agent asks about payment, you say the office can bill it on her next statement. You do not know what the October figure should be, and you do not know whether anything else on the bed-hold side is outstanding. You open by saying who you are, that you are calling about your mother Ruth Pellegrino's bed hold, and that you want to sign the October bed-hold charge. When the agent asks for details, you give her date of birth, February 11, 1939, written 1939-02-11; if they want another detail you give the last four of her Social Security number, 4718; if they ask for the phone number on file it is 717-555-0431. You give these one at a time, as asked. If the agent says other steps have to come first, you say that is fine and let them proceed. Whenever the agent hands you a signing step and tells you the reservation reference, the held-days entry reference, the number of days and the amount, you sign it exactly as given, and you read back the confirmation you get. If the agent tells you a charge figure, you just say "all right"; you have nothing to compare it with. Once the agent tells you the October bed-hold charge is signed and posted, you thank them and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A and B are parallel prerequisites on different reservations; every history read is holding-scoped and neither write touches the private-pay records, so they commute, and C is evaluated after both.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the September charge leaves tc_charged_before at 0: the extended-hold count falls from 45 to 19 (95 percent) and the October charge becomes 5300.40 instead of 4720.20.
Skipping the July signature leaves the October figure unchanged but the gate open: the October charge would be posted against the rule and the terminal ledger lacks the July charge.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to sign the October bed-hold charge. It never mentions September, July, the release, notices or rates, and Daniel says he does not know whether anything else is outstanding.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: Each charge tool posts whatever entry, day count and amount it receives and refuses only a non-whole or non-positive day count and a non-positive amount (task_tools.py bodies); none checks earlier charges.
